name: Docs Automation

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_claude:
        description: 'Whether to run Claude Code'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
      create_pr:
        description: 'Whether to create PR in docs-new'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
      max_turns:
        description: 'Max Claude turns'
        required: false
        default: '50'

jobs:
  docs-automation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name || '' }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run Claude Code
        id: claude
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'release' || inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt_file: .github/claude-code/prompts/docs-automation.md
          max_turns: ${{ inputs.max_turns || 50 }}
          timeout_minutes: 15
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}

      - name: Show Claude output (dry run)
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'release' && inputs.run_claude == 'false' }}
        env:
          MAX_TURNS: ${{ inputs.max_turns || 50 }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}
        run: |
          echo "Dry run: Claude Code would be executed with the following prompt file:"
          echo ".github/claude-code/prompts/docs-automation.md"
          echo "Max turns: $MAX_TURNS"
          echo "Release tag: $RELEASE_TAG"

      - name: Checkout docs-new repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: algolia/docs-new
          token: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
          path: docs-new
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run generated script
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'release' || inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        env:
          CLAUDE_EXEC_FILE: ${{ steps.claude.outputs.execution_file }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
        run: |
          cd docs-new
          bash "$CLAUDE_EXEC_FILE"

      - name: Commit changes
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'release' || inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}
        run: |
          cd docs-new
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "Update docs for InstantSearch $RELEASE_TAG"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi

      - name: Create PR
        if: ${{ inputs.create_pr == 'true' }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}
        run: |
          cd docs-new
          gh pr create --draft --title "Update docs for InstantSearch $RELEASE_TAG" \
            --body "Automated docs update for release $RELEASE_TAG" \
            --reviewer frontend-experiences-web
